answer: An agent marketplace requires a separate bond of 100 sable tokens for every identity allowed to bid on jobs, locked for 30 days in its glacier escrow contract. Creating 1,000 bidding identities therefore ties up 100,000 tokens for a month, imposing capital and borrowing costs even if the attacker wins no work. At the summit auction, each identity gets only one bid slot per bond, so splitting funds among aliases creates no free bidding capacity.
